objective: Fresh feature importance and candidate selection from original clean66 LR; freeze the newly selected columns; evaluate all six seasons and both Poisson fusions.
selection_mode: fresh one-time development search, then fixed selected columns across seasons
candidates: feature-family combinations, permutation-ranked subsets, positive-importance subset, window-only subsets, correlation pruning; as implemented in original feature-search code
season_assignment: raw CSV filename is authoritative; never calendar-month boundaries

bootstrap.primary: paired whole-date clusters stratified by season

interpretation: Development and all six historical seasons have previously been inspected. Full-range fixed-subset comparisons are retrospective. No outer result is used to change the new selection, LR settings, or fusion.
